//@version=6
strategy("TQ Alpha G1", overlay=true, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=false, initial_capital=50000, currency=currency.USD, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=1.0, slippage=1, pyramiding=0, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, max_bars_back=500, margin_long=10, margin_short=10)
// Quant Tournament - Generation 1 (spec: tournament/PHASE1_SPEC.md). Zero-repaint: bar-close signals,
// next-bar-open fills, no HTF request.security, no lookahead. Friction: $1/contract/side + 1 tick/side.
riskPct = input.float(1.0, "Risk % equity per trade", minval=0.1, maxval=2.0)
useChop = input.bool(true, "Chop filter: ADX<20 or range<0.35 dATR")
useDead = input.bool(true, "Midday dead zone 12:00-13:30 ET")

// ---------- time (America/New_York, bar OPEN time) ----------
tz = "America/New_York"
hhmm = hour(time, tz) * 100 + minute(time, tz)
dInt = year(time, tz) * 10000 + month(time, tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, tz)
inRTH = hhmm >= 930 and hhmm < 1600
rthStart = inRTH and not inRTH[1]

// ---------- session state, built in-script (no request.security on HTF) ----------
var float dH = na
var float dL = na
var float pdH = na
var float pdL = na
var float pdC = na
var float lastRthC = na
var float orH = na
var float orL = na
var float onH = na
var float onL = na
var float sPV = 0.0
var float sV = 0.0
var float dATR = na
var float rthOpen = na
var int nL = 0
var int nS = 0
if hhmm == 1800
    onH := high
    onL := low
else if not inRTH and not na(onH)
    onH := math.max(onH, high)
    onL := math.min(onL, low)
if rthStart
    if not na(dH)
        tr = math.max(dH, nz(pdC, dH)) - math.min(dL, nz(pdC, dL))
        dATR := na(dATR) ? tr : (dATR * 13 + tr) / 14
        pdH := dH
        pdL := dL
        pdC := lastRthC
    dH := high
    dL := low
    orH := high
    orL := low
    sPV := 0.0
    sV := 0.0
    rthOpen := open
    nL := 0
    nS := 0
else if inRTH
    dH := math.max(dH, high)
    dL := math.min(dL, low)
    if hhmm < 945
        orH := math.max(orH, high)
        orL := math.min(orL, low)
if inRTH
    sPV += hlc3 * volume
    sV += volume
    lastRthC := close
vwap_ = sV > 0 ? sPV / sV : na
orReady = inRTH and hhmm >= 945

// ---------- shared indicators ----------
atr = ta.atr(14)
[diP, diM, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
rangeOk = hhmm < 1030 or na(dATR) ? true : (dH - dL) / dATR >= 0.35
chopOK = not useChop or (adx >= 20 and rangeOk)
deadZ = useDead and hhmm >= 1200 and hhmm < 1330

// ---------- event filter: FOMC decision days (TradingView economic calendar) ----------
var fomc = array.from(20220126, 20220316, 20220504, 20220615, 20220727, 20220921, 20221102, 20221214, 20230201, 20230322, 20230503, 20230614, 20230726, 20230920, 20231101, 20231213, 20240131, 20240320, 20240501, 20240612, 20240731, 20240918, 20241107, 20241218, 20250129, 20250319, 20250507, 20250618, 20250730, 20250917, 20251029, 20251210, 20260128, 20260318, 20260429, 20260617, 20260729, 20260916, 20261028, 20261209)
isFomc = array.includes(fomc, dInt)
fomcBlock = isFomc and hhmm >= 1355 and hhmm < 1430

// ---------- VIX (same timeframe, confirmed bars only) ----------
vixC = request.security("CBOE:VIX", timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
vixH = request.security("CBOE:VIX", timeframe.period, high, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
var float vixLast = na
var float vixPrev = na
if rthStart
    vixPrev := vixLast
if inRTH
    vixLast := vixC
vixUp = not na(vixPrev) and vixC > vixPrev

// ---------- sizing: fixed-fractional risk ----------
f_qty(float dist) =>
    float q = 0.0
    if dist > 0
        q := math.floor(strategy.equity * riskPct / 100.0 / (dist * syminfo.pointvalue))
    q

flat = strategy.position_size == 0
barsIn = strategy.position_size != 0 ? bar_index - strategy.opentrades.entry_bar_index(0) : 0
var float stopPx = na
var float tgtPx = na
var float rPts = na
var float entRef = na
var bool trailOn = false

// ================= AGENT ALPHA: Opening-range / VWAP / DMI momentum =================
ema9 = ta.ema(close, 9)
volSma = ta.sma(volume, 20)
var bool upUsed = false
var bool dnUsed = false
if rthStart
    upUsed := false
    dnUsed := false
upBreak = orReady and not upUsed and close > orH
dnBreak = orReady and not dnUsed and close < orL
if upBreak
    upUsed := true
if dnBreak
    dnUsed := true

winA = ((hhmm >= 945 and hhmm < 1200) or (hhmm >= 1330 and hhmm < 1500)) and not deadZ
canEnter = flat and winA and chopOK and not fomcBlock

longSig = canEnter and upBreak and close > vwap_ and adx >= 20 and diP > diM and volume > volSma and nL == 0
// Short is NOT a mirror: requires VIX up on the day, no volume requirement, fixed 2R target + time stop
shortSig = canEnter and dnBreak and close < vwap_ and adx >= 20 and diM > diP and vixUp and nS == 0

if longSig
    q = f_qty(atr)
    if q >= 1
        stopPx := close - atr
        rPts := atr
        entRef := close
        trailOn := false
        strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, qty=q)
        strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
        nL += 1
if shortSig
    q = f_qty(atr)
    if q >= 1
        stopPx := close + atr
        tgtPx := close - 2.0 * atr
        rPts := atr
        entRef := close
        strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, qty=q)
        strategy.exit("XS", "S", stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
        nS += 1

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
    if high >= entRef + rPts
        trailOn := true
    if trailOn and close < ema9
        strategy.close("L", comment="trail EMA9")
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "S", stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
    if barsIn >= 6 and close > entRef - 0.5 * rPts
        strategy.close("S", comment="time stop")

// ---------- end-of-day flatten ----------
if hhmm >= 1550 or not inRTH
    strategy.close_all(comment="EOD")

var bool pendBull = false

var float swLo = na
var float swMid = na

        nS += 1

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
    if high >= entRef + rPts
        trailOn := true
    if trailOn and M < M[1] and M[1] < M[2]
        strategy.close("L", comment="mom fade")
    else if close < ema20
        strategy.close("L", comment="trail EMA20")
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "S", stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
    if M > M[1] and M[1] > M[2]
        strategy.close("S", comment="mom turn")

// ---------- end-of-day flatten ----------
if hhmm >= 1550 or not inRTH
    strategy.close_all(comment="EOD")

//@version=6
strategy("TQ Delta G1", overlay=true, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=false, initial_capital=50000, currency=currency.USD, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=1.0, slippage=1, pyramiding=0, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, max_bars_back=500, margin_long=10, margin_short=10)
// Quant Tournament - Generation 1 (spec: tournament/PHASE1_SPEC.md). Zero-repaint: bar-close signals,
// next-bar-open fills, no HTF request.security, no lookahead. Friction: $1/contract/side + 1 tick/side.
riskPct = input.float(1.0, "Risk % equity per trade", minval=0.1, maxval=2.0)
useChop = input.bool(true, "Chop filter: ADX<20 or range<0.35 dATR")
useDead = input.bool(true, "Midday dead zone 12:00-13:30 ET")

// ---------- time (America/New_York, bar OPEN time) ----------
tz = "America/New_York"
hhmm = hour(time, tz) * 100 + minute(time, tz)
dInt = year(time, tz) * 10000 + month(time, tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, tz)
inRTH = hhmm >= 930 and hhmm < 1600
rthStart = inRTH and not inRTH[1]

// ---------- session state, built in-script (no request.security on HTF) ----------
var float dH = na
var float dL = na
var float pdH = na
var float pdL = na
var float pdC = na
var float lastRthC = na
var float orH = na
var float orL = na
var float onH = na
var float onL = na
var float sPV = 0.0
var float sV = 0.0
var float dATR = na
var float rthOpen = na
var int nL = 0
var int nS = 0
if hhmm == 1800
    onH := high
    onL := low
else if not inRTH and not na(onH)
    onH := math.max(onH, high)
    onL := math.min(onL, low)
if rthStart
    if not na(dH)
        tr = math.max(dH, nz(pdC, dH)) - math.min(dL, nz(pdC, dL))
        dATR := na(dATR) ? tr : (dATR * 13 + tr) / 14
        pdH := dH
        pdL := dL
        pdC := lastRthC
    dH := high
    dL := low
    orH := high
    orL := low
    sPV := 0.0
    sV := 0.0
    rthOpen := open
    nL := 0
    nS := 0
else if inRTH
    dH := math.max(dH, high)
    dL := math.min(dL, low)
    if hhmm < 945
        orH := math.max(orH, high)
        orL := math.min(orL, low)
if inRTH
    sPV += hlc3 * volume
    sV += volume
    lastRthC := close
vwap_ = sV > 0 ? sPV / sV : na
orReady = inRTH and hhmm >= 945

// ---------- shared indicators ----------
atr = ta.atr(14)
[diP, diM, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
rangeOk = hhmm < 1030 or na(dATR) ? true : (dH - dL) / dATR >= 0.35
chopOK = not useChop or (adx >= 20 and rangeOk)
deadZ = useDead and hhmm >= 1200 and hhmm < 1330

// ---------- event filter: FOMC decision days (TradingView economic calendar) ----------
var fomc = array.from(20220126, 20220316, 20220504, 20220615, 20220727, 20220921, 20221102, 20221214, 20230201, 20230322, 20230503, 20230614, 20230726, 20230920, 20231101, 20231213, 20240131, 20240320, 20240501, 20240612, 20240731, 20240918, 20241107, 20241218, 20250129, 20250319, 20250507, 20250618, 20250730, 20250917, 20251029, 20251210, 20260128, 20260318, 20260429, 20260617, 20260729, 20260916, 20261028, 20261209)
isFomc = array.includes(fomc, dInt)
fomcBlock = isFomc and hhmm >= 1355 and hhmm < 1430

// ---------- VIX (same timeframe, confirmed bars only) ----------
vixC = request.security("CBOE:VIX", timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
vixH = request.security("CBOE:VIX", timeframe.period, high, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
var float vixLast = na
var float vixPrev = na
if rthStart
    vixPrev := vixLast
if inRTH
    vixLast := vixC
vixUp = not na(vixPrev) and vixC > vixPrev

// ---------- sizing: fixed-fractional risk ----------
f_qty(float dist) =>
    float q = 0.0
    if dist > 0
        q := math.floor(strategy.equity * riskPct / 100.0 / (dist * syminfo.pointvalue))
    q

flat = strategy.position_size == 0
barsIn = strategy.position_size != 0 ? bar_index - strategy.opentrades.entry_bar_index(0) : 0
var float stopPx = na
var float tgtPx = na
var float rPts = na
var float entRef = na
var bool trailOn = false

// ================= AGENT DELTA: Multi-timeframe regime pullback =================
ema9 = ta.ema(close, 9)
ema20 = ta.ema(close, 20)
ema50 = ta.ema(close, 50)
// HTF EMAs from CONFIRMED HTF closes, built in-script (identical historical vs realtime)
var float h1C = na
var float h1E20 = na
var float h1E50 = na
var float m15E9 = na
var float m15E21 = na
var int bearCnt15 = 0
if timeframe.change("60")
    c = close[1]
    h1C := c
    h1E20 := na(h1E20) ? c : h1E20 + 2.0 / 21.0 * (c - h1E20)
    h1E50 := na(h1E50) ? c : h1E50 + 2.0 / 51.0 * (c - h1E50)
if timeframe.change("15")
    c = close[1]
    m15E9 := na(m15E9) ? c : m15E9 + 2.0 / 10.0 * (c - m15E9)
    m15E21 := na(m15E21) ? c : m15E21 + 2.0 / 22.0 * (c - m15E21)
    bearCnt15 := m15E9 < m15E21 ? bearCnt15 + 1 : 0
add = request.security("USI:ADD", timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
addUp = add > 0 and add > add[3]
addDn = add < 0 and add < add[3]

biasLong = h1E20 > h1E50 and h1C > h1E20 and m15E9 > m15E21
biasShort = h1E20 < h1E50 and h1C < h1E20 and bearCnt15 >= 2

pbL = low <= ema20 and close > ema50
pbS = high >= ema20 and close < ema50
trigL = pbL[1] and close > high[1]
trigS = pbS[1] and close < low[1]

winD = ((hhmm >= 945 and hhmm < 1200) or (hhmm >= 1330 and hhmm < 1530)) and not deadZ
canEnter = flat and winD and chopOK and not fomcBlock
longSig = canEnter and biasLong and addUp and trigL and nL < 2
shortSig = canEnter and biasShort and addDn and trigS and nS < 2

if longSig
    st = math.min(low, low[1]) - 0.25 * atr
    d = close - st
    q = f_qty(d)
    if q >= 1
        stopPx := st
        rPts := d
        entRef := close
        strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, qty=q)
        strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
        nL += 1
if shortSig
    st = math.max(high, high[1]) + 0.25 * atr
    d = st - close
    q = f_qty(d)
    if q >= 1
        stopPx := st
        tgtPx := close - 1.5 * d
        rPts := d
        entRef := close
        trailOn := false
        strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, qty=q)
        strategy.exit("S1", "S", qty_percent=50, stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
        strategy.exit("S2", "S", stop=stopPx)
        nS += 1

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
    if close < ema20 and barsIn >= 1
        strategy.close("L", comment="trail EMA20")
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("S1", "S", qty_percent=50, stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
    strategy.exit("S2", "S", stop=stopPx)
    if low <= tgtPx
        trailOn := true
    if trailOn and close > ema9
        strategy.close("S", comment="trail EMA9")

// ---------- end-of-day flatten ----------
if hhmm >= 1550 or not inRTH
    strategy.close_all(comment="EOD")
